symbols.description: Get the vertical coordinate of the current scroll position of the page.

Get the scroll position of the current page, only if the page scroll mode is `SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER` or `SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER_HORIZONTAL` return the index of the current item (starting from `1`), otherwise return `undefined`.
No animation, scroll directly to the corresponding position
Scroll smoothly to the corresponding position
Free scrolling mode, system default scrolling mode
Swiper mode, vertical rotating map, walking lights, by configuring the height and number of individual pages can achieve the whole screen scrolling effect
Swiper mode, horizontal rotating map, walking lights, by configuring the width and number of individual pages can achieve the whole screen scrolling effect
Scroll the page to the specified position.

props.name: y
props.description: The vertical axis coordinates of the page, the 12 o'clock direction of the watch is positive, and scrolling down is negative

props.name: animConfig
props.description: Scroll animation configuration

props.name: anim_rate
props.description: Animation curve, optional values linear, easein, easeout, easeinout refer to [https://easings.net/](https://easings.net/)

props.name: anim_duration
props.description: Animation duration, in milliseconds

props.name: anim_fps
props.description: Animation frame rate

props.name: anim_complete_func
props.description: End of animation callback function

symbols.description: Set the current page scrolling position to be locked, i.e. the screen position will not change with the gesture swipe. After calling this API to perform the unlock operation, the page scrolling mode will be set to free scrolling mode.

props.name: lock
props.description: Whether to lock the current page scroll position

symbols.description: Set the scroll mode of the page.

props.name: mode
props.description: Page scroll mode, value reference page scroll mode constants

props.name: options
props.description: Other Options

props.name: height
props.description: Specify the height of a single item in Swiper, effective only if the scroll mode is SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER

props.name: count
props.description: Specify the number of items in the Swiper, effective only if the scroll mode is SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER or SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER_HORIZONTAL

props.name: width
props.description: Specify the width of a single item in Swiper, effective only if the scroll mode is SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER_HORIZONTAL

props.name: modeParams
props.description: Parameters for the scroll mode

props.name: scroll_frame_func
props.description: The callback function for each frame during scrolling

props.name: scroll_complete_func
props.description: The end of the scroll callback function

props.name: bounce
props.description: Control whether the page rebound effect is turned on. When the page content exceeds one screen, it is turned on by default. If the page content is less than one screen, it is turned off by default. This parameter needs to be passed in the build lifecycle to take effect.

props.name: type
props.description: Todo

props.name: yoffset
props.description: Pixel offset on the y axis

props.name: on_page
props.description: Callback function after page flipping, pageIndex is the page index after page flipping, and the index starts from 0

props.name: crown_enable
props.description: Whether to respond to crown events, the default response, you can use the crown to control page turning

symbols.description: Scrolls the page to the Swiper's target item, only if the current page scroll mode is `SCROLL_MODE_SWIPER`.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the target project, starting from 0

props.name: animation
props.description: Scrolling animation, value reference page scrolling animation constants
